title: Breaking text into lines
description:
Lay out a paragraph in a box with word wrapping and an ellipsis, as DirectWrite does.

```
box 120 px wide, 3 lines, each character 8 px
"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog again and again"
The quick brown
fox jumps over
the lazy dog...
```
hints: Build each line by adding the next word while `measure(line + " " + word) <= boxWidth` (lesson 4.03).
For the ellipsis, remove characters from the end of the last line until `measure(line + "...")` fits.
requirements: Measure words with a width function (8 px a character here; a real one would ask DirectWrite).
Break at spaces; a word longer than the box is broken by characters.
When the text does not fit in the lines, end the last line with `...` that also fits.
